'''Second Star to the Right''' is the 47th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on December 17, 2021. The set consists of 36 cards. 

==Type Breakdown==

*2 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*1 [[:Category:Doorway (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Doorway]]
*1 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (1 Federation)
*3 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*1 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*1 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*2 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
*24 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (13 Federation and 11 Klingon)
*1 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Federation)

==Rarity Breakdown==

*36 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
